text: The latch on the named casket lifts with a dry click. Inside, nestled in coarse cloth, sits a small oil phial sealed with wax and a scarred token of dark metal—worn smooth at the edges, as if carried for years. Nothing else. The other five caskets remain sealed and silent.

choices.label: Leave the alcove and press deeper into the tunnel
